```python
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx

# Generate the fixed graph G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
np.random.seed(17)
G = nx.erdos_renyi_graph(200, 0.3, seed=17)

# Convert to adjacency matrix for easier computation
adj_matrix = nx.adjacency_matrix(G).toarray()

# Start with a random partition
np.random.seed(42)  # For reproducible starting point
partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, 200)

# Local search improvement
def count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix):
    cut_count = 0
    for i in range(len(partition)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(partition)):
            if partition[i] != partition[j] and adj_matrix[i][j] == 1:
                cut_count += 1
    return cut_count

# Greedy local search
max_iterations = 1000
best_partition = partition.copy()
best_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix)

for iteration in range(max_iterations):
    improved = False
    for vertex in range(200):
        # Try flipping this vertex
        current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix)
        
        # Flip vertex
        partition[vertex] = 1 - partition[vertex]
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, adj_matrix)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            # Keep the flip
            if new_cut > best_cut:
                best_cut = new_cut
                best_partition = partition.copy()
            improved = True
        else:
            # Revert the flip
            partition[vertex] = 1 - partition[vertex]
    
    if not improved:
        break

# Try multiple random restarts to avoid local optima
for restart in range(10):
    np.random.seed(restart + 100)
    test_partition = np.random.randint(0, 2, 200)
    
    # Local search on this partition
    for iteration in range(200):
        improved = False
        for vertex in range(200):
            current_cut = count_cut_edges(test_partition, adj_matrix)
            test_partition[vertex] = 1 - test_partition[vertex]
            new_cut = count_cut_edges(test_partition, adj_matrix)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                if new_cut > best_cut:
                    best_cut = new_cut
                    best_partition = test_partition.copy()
                improved = True
            else:
                test_partition[vertex] = 1 - test_partition[vertex]
        
        if not improved:
            break
```
